facts.business: Ashnoor Textile Mills Limited is engaged in the manufacture and export of terry towels, operating a single manufacturing facility at Gurugram with over 70% of operating income from exports, primarily to the USA.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The outlook for financial year 2026-27 is expected to be comparatively better as the initial tariff shock gets progressively absorbed by the market and the business adjusts to the changed trade environment.
guidance_or_targets.value: Gradual reversal towards normalization of exports, together with a recovery in operating margins

key_risks: Significant concentration of exports in the USA
Tariff measures introduced by the US Government
Fluctuations in cotton yarn and other input prices
Global economic conditions and demand conditions
